text:
Maya P.: Heads up — noticed a mismatch in the tiered-credit A/B experiment allocations. A handful of prod customers got the new credit rates but should have been grandfathered. Sample attached below.

Samir K.: link pls — which cohort and when did we deploy the mapping? :thinking_face:

Maya P.: spreadsheet: https://docs.redwood/inv/metrics (read-only). Deployed mapping at 2026-03-16 02:10 UTC. Affected cohort = 'tiered-credits-B' (canary).

Alex R.: grabbing allocation table now. Quick peek: CSV export shows mismatch on customer_id vs account_id join. I think the transform step used wallet_id instead of billing_account_id.

Alex R.: CSV snippet:
```
user_id,account_id,cohort,applied_credit,legacy_plan
u_103,acc_987,tiered-credits-B,0.00,legacy-monthly
u_204,acc_112,tiered-credits-B,50.00,legacy-annual
u_305,acc_987,tiered-credits-B,75.00,legacy-monthly
```

Liam H.: that looks like the bug. Grandfathering rule looks up by legacy_plan on billing_account_id, but the join by wallet_id duplicates acc_987 leading to double-apply for some users. Proposed patch: change join key in billing-transform from wallet_id -> billing_account_id and add dedupe on account_id. Small config diff: 
```
- join_key: wallet_id
+ join_key: billing_account_id
+ dedupe: true
```

finance-bot: Automated experiment-audit: 432 customers with unexpected credit changes detected; expected ~120. Full audit: https://ops.redwood/audit/exp-1876543210.

Maya P.: thanks. Proposed immediate actions: 1) PAUSE cohort B rollout, 2) run a reverse-job to remove incorrectly-applied credits, 3) re-run transform with fix, 4) reapply credits deterministically. Need sign-off from Billing Ops and legal for any invoice edits >30 days old.

Billing Ops: OK to PAUSE. For invoices >30 days we should NOT edit historic invoices — issue credit memos instead. We'll need a short approval note for credits >$5k. :white_check_mark:

Samir K.: filing FIN-4823 now with steps + rollback plan, tagging @legal. Created ticket: https://jira.redwood/browse/FIN-4823. I'll set priority P1. Scheduling 3pm PT sync in 20m to walk through runbook.

Alex R.: will run a dry-run of the reverse-job on a subset (500 accounts) and post checksums. Query I'll run: 
```
SELECT account_id, SUM(applied_credit) as total_credit
FROM billing_events
WHERE experiment_id = 'tiered-credit-ab' AND ts >= '2026-03-16'
GROUP BY account_id
```

Liam H.: once dry-run looks good I'll push a hotfix to staging then to prod canary and we can re-run full job. Also adding a unit test for join key mapping.

Maya P.: action items assigned: Samir -> FIN-4823 + legal ping; Alex -> dry-run & checksum; Liam -> patch + tests; Billing Ops -> credit memo flow and threshold approvals. I'll hold the rollout and update the release board.

finance-bot: Dry-run completed for sample set (500 accounts). 47 mismatches flagged. Checksum: a1b2c3d4. Full run scheduled in 45m.

Maya P.: great — please post results in the ticket and update the rollout status. Thanks everyone. :pray:

Billing Ops: we'll prep credit memo template and approval thread. If any customers need immediate $$ protection, flag them in FIN-4823.
